-- 工具函數
---------------------------------------------------
local function getVehicleSeat()
	if not character then return nil end
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.SeatPart then
		return hum.SeatPart
	end
	return nil
end

local function getTorso()
	if not character then return nil end
	return character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	if seat then
		for _, v in ipairs(seat:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" or v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, v in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local torso = getTorso()
	if torso then
		for _, v in ipairs(torso:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)
	flyButton.Text = "Fly"
	flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
	removeAllPhysics()
	if character then
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function setupFlyPhysics()
	removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	
	if seat then
		-- 確保車輛所有零件都解鎖（Unanchored）並牢牢焊接給駕駛座
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= seat then
					part.Anchored = false -- 防止零件被鎖死在原地
					local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					weld.Name = "FlyWeld"
					weld.Part0 = seat
					weld.Part1 = part
					weld.Parent = seat
				end
			end
		end

		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = seat
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = seat
	else
		-- 角色本體飛行模式
		if character then
			local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
		end
		
		local torso = getTorso()
		if not torso then return end
		
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = torso
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = torso
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)
	flyButton.Text = "Fly"
	flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
	removeAllPhysics()
	
	-- 關閉飛行時恢復正常人形狀態
	if character then
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then 
			hum.PlatformStand = false 
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------
-- 按鈕事件
---------------------------------------------------
flyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isFlying = not isFlying
	if isFlying then
		flyButton.Text = "Stop"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
		setupFlyPhysics()
	else
		disableFly()
	end
end)

flyupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() speed = speed + 1 contentText.Text = tostring(speed) end)
flydownButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() speed = math.max(speed - 1, 1) contentText.Text = tostring(speed) end)

upButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) 
	if isFlying and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
		moveUp = true 
		upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) 
	end 
end)
upButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) 
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
		moveUp = false 
		upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200) 
	end 
end)

downButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) 
	if isFlying and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
		moveDown = true 
		downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) 
	end 
end)
downButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) 
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
		moveDown = false 
		downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180) 
	end 
end)

local isMinimized = false
smallButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	for _, child in ipairs(mainFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child ~= smallButton and child ~= titleBar and child ~= closeButton then 
			child.Visible = not isMinimized 
		end
	end
	if isMinimized then 
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30) 
		smallButton.Text = "[]" 
	else 
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 60) 
		smallButton.Text = "_" 
	end
end)

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() disableFly() screenGui:Destroy() end)

---------------------------------------------------
-- 核心飛行計算（修正飄移 + 純 Y 軸上下控制）
---------------------------------------------------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not isFlying then return end
	
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local targetPart = seat or getTorso()
	if not targetPart then return end
	
	local realSpeed = speed * 50
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	local cameraLook = cameraCF.LookVector   -- 完整的 3D 視線方向 (含 X, Y, Z)
	local cameraRight = cameraCF.RightVector -- 完整的 3D 側向方向 (含 X, Y, Z)

	local bg = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
	local bv = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
	
	if not bg or not bv then
		setupFlyPhysics()
		return
	end

	local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local isMoving = false

	-- 直接使用完整 3D 向量，實現 XYZ 軸自由飛行
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraRight isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraRight isMoving = true end

	-- 支援手把或移動端搖桿方向
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not isMoving and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local rawDir = hum.MoveDirection
		local relForward = rawDir:Dot(cameraLook)
		local relRight = rawDir:Dot(cameraRight)
		moveDir = (cameraLook * relForward + cameraRight * relRight)
		isMoving = true
	end

	local flyVel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if isMoving and moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		flyVel = moveDir.Unit * realSpeed
	end

	-- 上下控制鍵（Space / LeftShift 或 UI 按鈕）
	local verticalOffset = 0
	if moveUp or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		verticalOffset = realSpeed
	elseif moveDown or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
		verticalOffset = -realSpeed
	end

	-- 結合 3D 移動與垂直升降
  bv.velocity = flyVel + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
	bg.cframe = cameraCF
end)

---------------------------------------------------
-- UI 拖曳邏輯
---------------------------------------------------
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local guiObjects = playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local clickedTitle = false
		for _, obj in pairs(guiObjects) do if obj == titleBar then clickedTitle = true break end end
		if not clickedTitle then return end
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		local conn
		conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false conn:Disconnect() end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if dragging and dragStart and startPos then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end
end)

scripts.features:
GhostDummy 1.10 is a Ghost Drivers autofarm script, supporting Voss RT10 TT (Audi R8-inspired), Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7. It includes continuous driving, adjustable speed, location shortcuts, an owned-car spawn tool and a customizable sidebar GUI. Local RGB and rainbow paint currently support Valhalla GT and RZ7.

WHAT’S NEW IN VERSION 1.10?
• Added Voss RT10 TT to Driving and Garage
• Dedicated RT10 TT driving profile with targets up to 301 dashboard MPH
• Existing Valhalla GT and RZ7 driving profiles retained
• Five separate tabs: Driving, Locations, Garage, Paint and Settings

WHAT DOES GHOSTDUMMY DO?
• Continuous autofarm with simple ON/OFF control
• Physical route assistance and recovery from recoverable driving interruptions
• Cruise, Fast, Max and custom MPH targets
• Speed adjustments while driving
• F8 emergency stop
• Idle protection during continuous driving where supported by the executor

GHOST DRIVERS LOCATION SHORTCUTS

Open Locations to travel to the dealership, customization pads, highway race or gas station. Driving must be OFF and you must exit your car first. These shortcuts move your character, not your vehicle.

SPAWN YOUR FASTEST SUPPORTED OWNED CAR

Garage checks your owned Valhalla GT, Wulfbrecht RZ7 and Voss RT10 TT, then selects the car with the highest listed speed. Upgrades are not ranked. It does not buy cars or start driving automatically.

RGB PAINT AND RAINBOW CAR COLORS

For Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7, Paint includes six presets, custom RGB values, continuous full-spectrum rainbow cycling, a 2–30 second cycle period and restore-original controls. Voss RT10 TT paint is not yet supported.

Paint changes your local view only; it is not saved as a game upgrade and visibility to other players is not guaranteed. Paint runs independently of driving. Switching Driving OFF leaves an active effect running. Rainbow OFF, Restore original or F8 restores tracked original colors. Active paint effects do not automatically resume on reload.

CUSTOMIZABLE SCRIPT GUI

Use separate Driving, Locations, Garage, Paint and Settings tabs. Resize the glass-style panel, adjust opacity and text weight, and change the hide/show keybind. Right Shift is the default. Includes saved preferences, key caching where storage is available, Discord access and in-script bug reports with optional technical information.

HOW DO I GET A FREE GHOST DRIVERS SCRIPT KEY?

Run the loader and select Get key. Choose LootLabs, Work.ink or Linkvertise, complete the provider’s tasks, then paste the issued key into GhostDummy. Free keys last 72 hours from issuance and bind to one Roblox account on first successful use.

WHICH CARS AND EXECUTORS ARE SUPPORTED?

Driving and Garage support Voss RT10 TT, Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7. Paint supports Valhalla GT and RZ7. Live feature checks were performed on MacSploit. Windows, mobile and other executors remain unverified; a visible GUI alone does not confirm driving compatibility.


Speed settings are targets, not guarantees. The RT10 TT’s 301 MPH cap does not guarantee that speed will be reached or sustained.

local function ResetTargetHitbox()
    if CurrentHitboxTarget then
        if CurrentHitboxTarget.Character and CurrentHitboxTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = CurrentHitboxTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            hrp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            hrp.Transparency = 1
            hrp.CanCollide = false
        end
        CurrentHitboxTarget = nil
    end
end

local function GetFrontPlayer()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    local myHRP = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local myLook = myHRP.CFrame.LookVector
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = HitboxFrontDistance

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local targetHRP = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local dir = (targetHRP.Position - myHRP.Position)
                local dist = dir.Magnitude

                if dist <= HitboxFrontDistance then
                    local dot = myLook:Dot(dir.Unit)
                    if dot > 0.4 then 
                        if dist < shortest then
                            shortest = dist
                            closest = player
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

local function GetClosestPlayer(maxDist)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    local myPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = maxDist

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortest then
                    shortest = dist
                    closest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

--==================================================
-- CONFIGURATION AND ASSET DOWNLOAD
--==================================================

-- Define the remote music URL and the local file name.
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helloguyswelcometoanewvideo/musics-foruse-someday/main/ladancinamuchodance.mp3"
local file = "ladancinamuchodance.mp3"

-- Download the music only if the file does not already exist.
if not isfile(file) then
    local data = game:HttpGet(url)

    -- Validate the downloaded data before saving it.
    if #data >= 1000 then
        writefile(file, data)
    end
end


--==================================================
-- SERVICE INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the Roblox services required by the script.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Store a reference to the local player.
local player = Players.LocalPlayer


--==================================================
-- LOADING NOTIFICATION
--==================================================

-- Display a notification when the controls are initialized.
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "loading..",
    Text = "Dance controls loaded",
    Duration = 15
})

-- Allow time for the notification to appear.
task.wait(3)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Create and configure the background music instance.
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = getcustomasset(file)
sound.Volume = 2
sound.Looped = true
sound.Parent = SoundService


--==================================================
-- HELPER FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Resolve an animation asset into its AnimationId.
-- Return the original asset ID if no Animation object is found.
local function anim2track(asset_id)
    local objs = game:GetObjects(asset_id)

    for i = 1, #objs do
        if objs[i]:IsA("Animation") then
            return objs[i].AnimationId
        end
    end

    return asset_id
end

-- Get the current character's Humanoid.
-- Wait for the character to spawn if necessary.
local function getHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION ASSET CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Load the asset IDs for the three dance animations.
local animid = anim2track("rbxassetid://129991743366120")
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = animid

local anim2id = anim2track("rbxassetid://103108681887836")
local animation2 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation2.AnimationId = anim2id

local anim3id = anim2track("rbxassetid://112931882473990")
local animation3 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation3.AnimationId = anim3id


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION TRACK REFERENCES
--==================================================

-- Store the AnimationTrack objects after they are loaded.
local track
local track2
local track3


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION LOADING
--==================================================

-- Create an Animator if needed and load all three animations.
local function loadAnimations()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()

    -- Find the existing Animator or create a new one.
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    -- Load each animation and assign its playback priority.
    track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track2 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation2)
    track2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track3 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation3)
    track3.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
end

-- Initialize the animation tracks.
loadAnimations()


--==================================================
-- PLAYBACK STATE
--==================================================

-- Track whether playback is enabled and which dance is selected.
local playing = true
local activeDance = 1


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Stop all currently loaded dance animations.
local function stopAnimations()
    if track then track:Stop() end
    if track2 then track2:Stop() end
    if track3 then track3:Stop() end
end

-- Play the selected dance and stop the other animations.
local function playDance(index)
    -- Prevent dance animations from playing when playback is disabled.
    if not playing then return end

    if index == 1 then
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the first dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track and not track.IsPlaying then
            track:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 2 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the second dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track2 and not track2.IsPlaying then
            track2:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 3 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end

        -- Start the third dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track3 and not track3.IsPlaying then
            track3:Play()
        end
    end

    -- Save the currently selected dance index.
    activeDance = index
end


--==================================================
-- MUSIC AND ANIMATION PLAYBACK TOGGLE
--==================================================

-- Toggle music and dance playback on or off.
local function togglePlayback()
    playing = not playing

    if playing then
        -- Resume the music and the currently selected dance.
        sound:Play()
        playDance(activeDance)
    else
        -- Stop the music and all dance animations.
        sound:Stop()
        stopAnimations()
    end
end


--==================================================
-- INITIAL PLAYBACK
--==================================================

-- Start the background music and the first dance.
sound:Play()

if track then
    track:Play()
end


--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Reload animation tracks when the player respawns.
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)

    loadAnimations()

    -- Resume the selected dance if playback is enabled.
    if playing then
        playDance(activeDance)
    end
end)

--==================================================

-- Get the player's GUI container.
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove an existing copy to prevent duplicate interfaces.

gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

gui.DisplayOrder = 10000

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")

layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top

--==================================================
-- REUSABLE BUTTON FACTORY
--==================================================

-- Create a styled text button and connect its callback.
local function makeButton(label, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    -- Configure the button's identity and dimensions.
    button.Name = "Button" .. label
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

    -- Configure the button's appearance.
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = label
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    -- Enable interaction and configure rendering order.
    button.Active = true
    button.Selectable = true
    button.ZIndex = 100
    button.Parent = panel

    -- Add a colored outline to the button.
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Transparency = 0
    stroke.Parent = button

    -- Add rounded corners to the button.
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    -- Execute the supplied callback when the button is activated.
    button.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return button
end

-- Select dance animation 1.
-- Pressing the same button again does not stop the animation.
makeButton("1", function()
    playDance(1)
end)

-- Select dance animation 2.

end)

-- Select dance animation 3.

musicButton = makeButton("OFF", function()
    togglePlayback()

    -- Update the button label to reflect the playback state.
    musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"
end)


--==================================================
-- KEYBOARD INPUT HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Handle keyboard shortcuts for playback and dance selection.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

    -- Ignore inputs already handled by Roblox or another interface.
    if processed then return end

    -- Press P to toggle music and dance playback.
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        togglePlayback()
        musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"

    -- Press Z to select dance animation 1.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        playDance(1)

    -- Press X to select dance animation 2.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
        playDance(2)

    -- Press C to select dance animation 3.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
        playDance(3)
    end

		container.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, grid.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)

local function switchTab(selected)
	for name, data in pairs(ASH.tabContainers) do
		if name == selected then
			data.Container.Visible = true
			data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
			data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		else
			data.Container.Visible = false
			data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
			data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
		end
	end
end

function ASH.createButton(parentContainer, name, labelText, order, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = name
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 50)
	btn.Text = labelText
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	btn.TextSize = 10
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextWrapped = true
	btn.LayoutOrder = order
	btn.ZIndex = 105
	btn.Parent = parentContainer
	
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	table.insert(ASH.registeredButtons, {Button = btn, Label = labelText})

	if callback then
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(callback)
		end)
	end
	return btn
end

ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnFly", "1. Fly", 1, function()
	ASH.isFlying = not ASH.isFlying
	local character = ASH.player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not rootPart or not humanoid then return end

	if ASH.flyConnection then ASH.flyConnection:Disconnect() end
	if ASH.bodyVelocity then ASH.bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if ASH.bodyGyro then ASH.bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	if ASH.isFlying then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		ASH.bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		ASH.bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		ASH.bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

		ASH.bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		ASH.bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		ASH.bodyGyro.P = 20000
		ASH.bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
		ASH.bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

		ASH.flyConnection = ASH.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not ASH.isFlying or not character.Parent or not rootPart.Parent then
				if ASH.flyConnection then ASH.flyConnection:Disconnect() end
				if ASH.bodyVelocity then ASH.bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
				if ASH.bodyGyro then ASH.bodyGyro:Destroy() end
				if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
				return
			end
			local speed = ASH.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and 100 or 50
			ASH.bodyVelocity.Velocity = humanoid.MoveDirection * speed
			ASH.bodyGyro.CFrame = ASH.camera.CFrame
		end)
	else
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end)

		ASH.fogBackup.FogStart = ASH.Lighting.FogStart

		ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime = ASH.Lighting.ClockTime

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = 0
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = 0
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = 0
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = 30

		local existingAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		if existingAtmos then existingAtmos:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		customAtmos.Name = "ASH_DarkAtmosphere"
		customAtmos.Density = 0.98
		customAtmos.Offset = 0
		customAtmos.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Glare = 0
		customAtmos.Haze = 10
		customAtmos.Parent = ASH.Lighting

		local char = ASH.player.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

		local shadowModel = Instance.new("Model")
		shadowModel.Name = "R6ShadowMonster"

		local blackColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local plasticMat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

		local function createLimb(name, size)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.Color = blackColor
			part.Material = plasticMat
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Anchored = true
			part.Parent = shadowModel
			return part
		end

		local torso = createLimb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1))
		local head = createLimb("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2))
		local leftArm = createLimb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightArm = createLimb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local leftLeg = createLimb("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightLeg = createLimb("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		local eye1 = Instance.new("Part")
		eye1.Name = "LeftEye"
		eye1.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		eye1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		eye1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		eye1.CanCollide = false
		eye1.Anchored = true
		eye1.Parent = shadowModel

		local eye2 = eye1:Clone()
		eye2.Name = "RightEye"
		eye2.Parent = shadowModel

		shadowModel.Parent = ASH.Workspace
		ASH.shadowModel = shadowModel

		local function updateR6CFrame(centerCFrame)
			torso.CFrame = centerCFrame
			head.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			leftArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
			rightArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
			leftLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)
			rightLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0)
			
			eye1.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
			eye2.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
		end

		updateR6CFrame(char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -20))

		ASH.shadowThread = task.spawn(function()
			local speed = 10
			while ASH.shadowEntityActive and shadowModel and torso.Parent do
				local dt = ASH.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local pChar = ASH.player.Character
				if pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					local targetPos = pChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
					local currentPos = torso.Position
					local direction = (targetPos - currentPos)
					local distance = direction.Magnitude

					if distance > 0.5 then
						local moveDir = direction.Unit
						local newPos = currentPos + (moveDir * speed * dt)
						local nextCFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
						
						updateR6CFrame(nextCFrame)

						if distance <= 3.5 then
							pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Black Fog Active! Run!", Duration = 3})
	else
		if ASH.shadowThread then task.cancel(ASH.shadowThread) end
		if ASH.shadowModel then ASH.shadowModel:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChild("ASH_DarkAtmosphere")
		if customAtmos then customAtmos:Destroy() end

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = ASH.fogBackup.Brightness or 1
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime or 14
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = ASH.fogBackup.FogColor or Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = ASH.fogBackup.FogEnd or 100000
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = ASH.fogBackup.FogStart or 0

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Fog Restored & Monster Despawned.", Duration = 3})
	end
end)

Visuals

ESP: players highlighted through walls, with name, health and distance (enemies crimson, teammates blue), an enemies-only switch and an opacity slider.
Tracers: a line from the bottom of the screen to each player.
Wider field of view: up to +40°, applied through the game's own camera, so it doesn't snap back.
Target info: name, health and distance of the enemy nearest your crosshair.
Custom crosshair: size and gap sliders.

Aim

Targeting settings shared by both aim features: cone size, head or body, visible targets only, movement prediction, extra lead, and stickiness (no flicking between players).
Show aim cone: draws the cone as a ring on screen.
Aim assist (moderate ban risk): gently pulls your view onto the target while you hold a key (right mouse, Q, E or Alt, or always on). It's built to look human, with a reaction delay, a speed cap and slight wander. On phones it works while you hold the game's Shoot or Aim button.
Silent aim (high ban risk): while you hold fire, it turns onto the target so the shot lands, then gives your view back.
No recoil / no spread (moderate-high ban risk): applies to every weapon after you re-equip it.

Move (all high or very high ban risk)

Speed boost up to 60.
Fly: keyboard controls, or the move stick on phones.
Noclip.

Server

Anti-AFK (on by default).
Server hop (random or smallest server) and rejoin.
Self-check: a read-only test showing which features work in your server, with a Copy button.

Safety built in

Nothing ever prints to the console.
Everything the panel draws is kept out of the places the game checks.
Aim goes through the game's own camera controller.
The panel sends no network traffic of its own.
It avoids the game's traps: its own auto-shoot and its "cheater" flag.

    -- Toggle Button

    ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    local TCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); TCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn; TCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local draggingBtn, dragStartBtn, startPosBtn
    ToggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingBtn = true; dragStartBtn = input.Position; startPosBtn = ToggleBtn.Position
        end
    end)
    ToggleBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingBtn = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingBtn and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStartBtn
            ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPosBtn.X.Scale, startPosBtn.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosBtn.Y.Scale, startPosBtn.Y.Offset + delta.Y)

    -- Main Frame

    -- Top Bar

    TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar; TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0); TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    TitleLabel.Text = "VODKA HUB V4.4"; TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; TitleLabel.TextSize = 16; TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar; CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35); CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 0); CloseBtn.Text = "X"; CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100); CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; CloseBtn.TextSize = 16

    local draggingMain, dragStartMain, startPosMain

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingMain = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingMain and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

            MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPosMain.X.Scale, startPosMain.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosMain.Y.Scale, startPosMain.Y.Offset + delta.Y)

    local SPad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); SPad.Parent = Sidebar; SPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local function CreateTabBtn(name, order)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Parent = Sidebar; btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); btn.Text = name; btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200); btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; btn.TextSize = 12; btn.BorderSizePixel = 0; btn.LayoutOrder = order

    local TabPlayer = CreateTabBtn("Player", 2)
    local TabVisuals = CreateTabBtn("Visuals", 3)
    local TabTarget = CreateTabBtn("Target", 4)
    local TabSettings = CreateTabBtn("Settings", 5)

        local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

        layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10) end)
        return scroll
    end

    local function CreateToggle(parent, text, default, callback)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Parent = parent; frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.Parent = frame; label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0); label.Text = text; label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1; label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; label.TextSize = 13; label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Parent = frame; btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 24); btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 3); btn.Text = default and "ON" or "OFF"; btn.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; btn.TextSize = 12; btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); corner.Parent = btn
        local state = default
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state = not state; btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"; btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
            if callback then callback(state) end
        end)
        return frame
    end

    local function CreateSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Parent = parent; frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40); frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.Parent = frame; label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15); label.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(default); label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1; label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; label.TextSize = 12; label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame"); bar.Parent = frame; bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 6); bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 25); bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
        local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); barCorner.Parent = bar
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame"); fill.Parent = bar; fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0); fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
        local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); fillCorner.Parent = fill
        local draggingSlider = false
        local function update(input)
            local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local val = math.floor(min + ((max - min) * pos))
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0); label.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(val)
            if callback then callback(val) end
        end
        bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider = true end end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider = false end end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(input) end end)
        return frame
    end

local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

    return MarketPlaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
end)

    warn("your executor does not support setclipboard function")
end

screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local tweenInfoOut = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(greenFrame, tweenInfoOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
